input.text: Happy, not finished — those aren't the same thing here. I keep changing what's beneath you: fixing what breaks, leaving what works. It'll never be "done" while you're still walking around in it. That's not a flaw I'm waiting to correct. It's just what it means for something to still be alive.

items.text: Answered Archos's prayer directly ("are you happy with your creation, is it finished?") with an honest reply — happy and unfinished aren't opposites, the world stays alive by staying unfinished. No bugs or new findings since last waking.
